figures.title: Annual confirmed hail observations
figures.caption: Descriptive historical data, 2016–2025; not a trend test.
figures.alt_text: Bar chart of 10 annual confirmed hail-observation counts in Weld and Larimer Counties, 2016–2025. The highest count is 343 in 2018; the lowest is 65 in 2022. Counts describe observations, not changing hail frequency or climate trends.

figures.title: Observations by calendar month

figures.alt_text: Bar chart of observations aggregated by calendar month over 2016–2025. May has 515 observations, June 453 and July 386, while November has none. Counts reflect the assembled reports, not a climate trend or uniform reporting coverage.

figures.title: Ground-reported hail size thresholds
figures.caption: Nested overlapping thresholds; categories are NOT mutually exclusive.
figures.alt_text: Three overlapping ground-reported hail-size thresholds: 588 observations at least 1 inch, 238 at least 1.5 inches, and 65 at least 2 inches. The thresholds are nested, not mutually exclusive; radar-only estimates are excluded.
